title: Puzzle2d Live Peer Sync
description: Restore commit-93 canvas speed while keeping commit-94 live cross-pane node-move/delete sync, by replacing per-frame full-scene WASM re-push on peer panes with lightweight incremental per-node position update in Rust/WASM BoardSession.
summary: Added BoardHost.set_node_positions / BoardSession.setNodePositionsJson for O(moved-nodes) peer-pane sync during drags. Peer applyNodePositionSilent now queues pendingIncrementalNodeMoves instead of nulling lastPushedDescriptorJson; pushSceneToWasmDriver flushes incremental moves and skips full syncDescriptorJson when the descriptor cache is still valid. Rust host test + extended vitest peer broadcast test confirm incremental path. wasm rebuilt; cargo test + 88 vitest tests pass.
